result.keywords: We present a constant-factor heuristic for the dynamic asymmetric traveling salesman problem (DATSP). Our approach combines population-based search with local improvement and is analyzed against a standard linear-programming relaxation under time-varying edge costs. The main idea is to reduce the dynamic problem to a sequence of subtour-constrained cover instances, where local connectivity and re-optimization are used to preserve solution quality. We then show how a hybrid metaheuristic can be integrated with this reduction to obtain a robust approximation procedure for dynamic ATSP instances.
result.title: A Constant-factor Heuristic for the Dynamic Asymmetric Traveling Salesman Problem
